chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, who said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Yusuf ibn al-Harith, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Arzami, from his father, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon them,
He said: Charity is not permitted for the sons of Hashim except in two cases: if they are thirsty and find water, then they drink it; and the charity of one of them upon the other.

key_terms.لِبَنِي هَاشِمٍ: For the sons of Hashim (the Prophet's clan)

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible for Banu Hashim to receive charity?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Khisal clarifies the specific legal restrictions on Banu Hashim receiving sadaqah, distinguishing it from the general distribution of zakat. It highlights the unique status of the Prophet's clan, noting that while they are generally excluded from general charity to preserve their dignity, they may accept it in cases of extreme necessity (like thirst) or within their own lineage. This ruling is central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the purity and distinct financial status of the Ahl al-Bayt.
